text: Righto, sport, and this is my favourite time of year, finals footy is here. Both the NRL and AFL are deep into their finals series now, and there's a real buzz around Brisbane with our local sides right in the thick of the action.

speaker: alice
text: You can feel it around town too, pubs are packed, jerseys are out and everyone's got an opinion on who's going all the way this year. Doesn't matter which code you follow, finals time just hits different.

speaker: charlie
text: Too right, nothing like a bit of September footy to get the blood pumping. Good luck to all the Queensland sides still standing, we'll be cheering you on.
